# Collecting Customer Birthday

Available on **All plans**.

## Where birthday data lives

Joy reads from BOTH locations and keeps them synced:
- **Shopify Customer Notes** under the field name `Birthday` (or your configured name)
- **Shopify Customer Metafields** if a valid date metafield exists

## Limitations & options

- **Choose the gift:** when several birthday gift options are configured, a setting lets the customer pick one from the set.
- **POS can't capture birthdays:** Shopify POS does not capture a birthday at signup — customers add it in their Joy profile online (or via the registration form / metafields below).

## Method 1 — Registration form (legacy customer accounts only)

Joy reads the birthday from the **Shopify customer note** that the store's registration
form writes. The note field name Joy looks for defaults to `Birthday`.

Adding a birthday field to the registration form is **theme work on the merchant's side** —
Joy does not inject the field into the form. It requires Shopify's **legacy (classic)
customer accounts**, the only mode where the registration template can be customized.

**Steps for the merchant:**
1. Confirm the store uses **legacy (classic) customer accounts**
2. Edit theme `customers/register.liquid` and add a birthday field (date picker) that saves
   to the customer note under the name `Birthday`
3. On registration, the value lands in the Shopify customer note → syncs to Joy via the
   Shopify customer-creation webhook

**If the form uses a different note field name:** the name Joy reads is configured by the
team, not by the merchant. Collect the exact field name the merchant's form writes, then
escalate to the team to set it for the shop — append `<escalate_human>` to the reply.

**On new customer accounts:** Shopify's new customer accounts do not allow editing the
registration template, so this method does not apply. Use **Method 2 — sync from
metafields** below, or have customers add their birthday in their Joy profile online.

## Method 2 — Sync from metafields

If birthdays already live in **Shopify Customer Metafields** (manually maintained, migrated, or set by a third-party app), Joy reads the metafield directly. No form changes needed.

## Format

Birthdays must be valid date format. CSV imports require the column **`Birthday(MM/DD)`** with format `MM/DD` (zero-padded — `03/03` correct, `3/3` wrong).

## Why birthdays matter

- Power **Birthday reward** earning rule
- Power **Member exclusive deal** dynamic active dates ("Month of birth")
- Used by **Place order** date range option ("Month of birth")

# Loyalty Landing Page

The **dedicated loyalty page** (a standalone landing page, Online Store 2.0-integrated) is a **paid feature — available on Essential ($29/mo) and above**. It is **NOT available on the free Starter plan**. On Starter, the Loyalty page section in Joy Admin shows an **Upgrade** prompt instead of the Create Page button.

**Plan availability:**

| Plan | Loyalty page |
|---|---|
| **Starter** (free) | ❌ Not available — shows Upgrade prompt |
| **Essential** ($29/mo) | ✅ Available ("On-brand loyalty page") |
| **Advanced** ($129/mo) | ✅ Available |
| **Ultimate** ($499/mo) | ✅ Available |

A few individual blocks are gated higher than the page itself — e.g. **Joy: My rewards** needs **Advanced+** (see block table below).

> ⚠️ **Grandfathered stores:** some **older stores** installed before the 2025 plan-feature limits may still have the loyalty page on Starter. This is legacy behavior — do **not** promise it to new merchants. For **any store that installed recently**, the loyalty page requires **Essential or above**.

**When a Starter (free) merchant asks how to direct customers to their loyalty program** (they can't create the page): tell them the page requires Essential+, and give them the **widget deeplink** as a free alternative — add `#joy-home` to their store URL to auto-open the loyalty widget. Example: `https://yourstore.myshopify.com/#joy-home`. This works on all plans, including free.

When a merchant asks "do I need a paid plan for the loyalty page", the answer is: **yes** — the dedicated loyalty page starts on **Essential**. On the free Starter plan, use the `#joy-home` widget deeplink instead to send customers to the loyalty widget.

## Setup

1. **Shopify Admin → Online Store → Themes → Customize**
2. Open page selector → choose **Joy Loyalty** template
3. **Apps** in left menu → add Joy blocks (drag-drop to position)

Alternatively, customize loyalty page blocks directly at **Joy Admin → On-site content → Loyalty page**.

## SEO

**Shopify Admin → Online Store → Pages → [your loyalty page] → Edit website SEO** — set page handle, title, meta description.

## March 2025 improvements

- **Logged-in / logged-out state toggle** — floating button in editor previews both states without actually logging in
- **Browse images + remove-background** utility built into the block editor
- Optimized theme editor performance — fewer loader spinners on each update

---

All blocks add via **Theme Editor → loyalty page → Add Block / Add Section → Apps**. The loyalty page itself requires **Essential+**, so the "Plan" column below refers to plans that already have the page (Essential and above) — **not** the free Starter plan.

| Block | Purpose | Plan |
|---|---|---|
| Joy Hero Banner | Big top visual / promo | Essential+ |
| Joy: How it works | Plain explanation of program mechanics | Essential+ |
| Joy: Ways to earn | Lists all earning programs (auto-pulled from your rules) | Essential+ |
| Joy: Ways to redeem | Lists redemption options | Essential+ |
| Joy: Rewards activity | Customer dashboard — points, history | Essential+ |
| Joy: Referral block | Referral CTA + sharing | Essential+ |
| Joy: VIP Tier benefits | Tier list + perks (auto-syncs with Membership → VIP Tier) | Essential+ |
| Joy: Sign-up banner | Top/bottom/slide-in banner inviting signup | Essential+ |
| Joy: Loyalty Program FAQs | Q&A section | Essential+ |
| Joy: Coming soon teaser | Pre-launch hype + email collection | Essential+ |
| Joy: My rewards | Show available rewards | Advanced, Ultimate |

## Important block notes

**Reordering Ways to redeem:** the order of redeeming programs is controlled in the **Reward programs** menu — drag to reorder them (e.g. lowest → highest points). If the merchant tells us the desired order, the team can reorder them on request.


- **Ways to earn / Ways to redeem** — order is controlled in **Reward programs** menu, not the block
- **VIP Tier block** — pulls from VIP Tier program (single source of truth). Manage tiers/perks at **Membership → VIP Tier → Perks**. Older block versions show **Upgrade now** to switch to the new layout
- Free product perks include an expand control to reveal actual products

---

## Program icons (Ways to earn / Ways to redeem)

Program icons are set **per surface** — the widget and the loyalty page each have their own
icon settings, so changing one does not change the other.

**Widget icons:** **On-site content → Loyalty widget → Set up the Widget → Section → Ways to
earn → Customize programs** — click a program to change its icon.

**Loyalty page icons:** **On-site content → Loyalty page → edit the "Ways to earn" block** —
click each program to upload a custom icon URL.

## AI icon generator

**Generate AI Icon** applies to the **widget float button icon**. Find it in the widget setup
under the float button's **Display** settings (**Button icon → Generate AI Icon**): enter a
prompt and regenerate until it matches the brand. Available on **Essential and above**.

Program icons in Ways to earn / Ways to redeem are set with the icon pickers above.
